lines.2: I leaned back and looked up at the blue sky.
lines.4: 「Hey, even that gorgeous announcer Yukihiro is out by the school gate.」
lines.5: 「Even a TV station showed up. That's the regionally famous Sports and Martial Arts Festival for you.」
lines.6: 「Using real horses in the cavalry battle is bound to get people talking.」
lines.8: 「Let's make today a fun and fiery one.」
lines.10: 「The Sports and Martial Arts Festival divides us into four armies--East, West, South, and North--that compete on points.」
lines.11: 「I'm in 3-A, so I'm in the East Army with 2-A. You're in 2-C, so you're in the West Army with 3-C and 1-B. In other words, East and West make us enemies.」
lines.12: 「If we meet in an event, I won't show you any mercy.」
lines.14: So Otome and I were enemies...
lines.15: It was reassuring to have the Princess and Subaru on my side, though.
lines.16: Wait, if 1-B was in the West Army too, that meant Nagomi was on our side.
lines.17: Yohei Murata and Nishizaki from 2-A were squarely on the enemy side.
lines.18: And Konoe was an enemy too.
lines.19: This was shaping up to be one heated battle.
lines.20: 「Morning, Tsushima, Date! Class 2-C's camp is over here.」
lines.22: 「Yep. Everyone's in a festival mood, so morale is high.」
lines.26: 「Illness, injury, hardship--those are the signs I see.」
lines.27: 「Even so, I do see victory in the end, but the indication is so faint...」
lines.28: 「So it all comes down to how hard we try?」
lines.29: 「Yes. I believe all of you can win.」
lines.31: The hot-blooded Class 2-C crowd raised their fists with a mighty cheer.
lines.32: Fireworks thundered into the sky in broad daylight.
lines.34: 「Don't sulk just because you couldn't get Yukihiro's autograph.」
lines.37: 「Hey, isn't your face kind of red?」
lines.38: 「Yeah. It's been red since she got here this morning.」
lines.40: 「My head's just a little fuzzy, and I'm sneezing, that's all.」
lines.41: 「Then that is a cold! A cold is the root of all illness!」
lines.42: 「Don't push yourself. Go get some rest.」
lines.43: 「Heh. This is just the right handicap.」
lines.44: 「Hey, she can still make roses even with a cold!」
lines.45: 「So this sluggish feeling is what a cold's like. I don't think I want to experience this again.」
lines.47: 「But Princess, did you have to catch a cold now of all times?」
lines.48: 「And whose fault do you think that is? Take that! And that!」
lines.50: 「Otome gave you the same cold-water punishment and you're still bursting with energy.」
lines.52: 「Ha ha! Leo, she's talking about you. Well, you really are an idiot, so that's fair.」
lines.53: ...An idiot just called me an idiot...
lines.55: And thus the Sports and Martial Arts Festival solemnly got under way.
lines.56: Third-year girls' mounted race: first place, Otome Kurogane.
lines.58: Otome posed with her horse for the press.
lines.59: So this was how the Sports and Martial Arts Festival kept getting more famous...
lines.60: Second-year girls' interclass relay: first place, Class 2-C.
lines.61: 「All right! That's our Princess. You nailed the finish!」
lines.65: 「I'm fiiine! You saw me pass two runners as anchor.」
lines.68: 「Coconuuut! We're in the same army, so put some fire into it!」
lines.69: 「God, she's annoying... If you guys hadn't come to watch, I'd definitely have skipped an event this conspicuous... What does my slip say...?」
lines.78: 「Let's go for first place while we're at it! Think you can keep up with me?」
lines.81: 「They passed everyone ahead of them and took first!」
lines.85: 「Oh, right. I'm teamed up with you guys.」
lines.86: 「We'll win if we just keep a steady pace. Relax.」
lines.87: 「From here on, our exploits will be depicted in long, lingering detail!」
lines.88: Second-year boys' three-man four-legged race--Tsushima, Date, and Samesuga: first place.
lines.89: 「Man, I feel like we just got totally skipped over!」
lines.90: 「Well, the three of us together are pretty damn strong.」
lines.91: 「Me and Leo are already unbeatable on our own.」
lines.92: 「Isn't that one person short? Did adding me make us weaker?」
lines.93: 「Huh? What's going on? Sounds noisy over there.」
lines.95: 「What?! Two of the guys slated to play baseball got hurt in the three-man four-legged race?!」
lines.96: 「We got too fired up and fell...」
lines.97: 「And then you went out of your way to get yourselves trampled?」
lines.98: That's the Sports and Martial Arts Festival for you--it isn't satisfied until it sees blood.
lines.99: 「What should we do about finding two replacements for the baseball team?」
lines.102: 「Idiot! This is our chance to show off!」
lines.105: 「...Between this and the Princess's cold, we've got a lot to worry about.」
lines.106: 「I'm telling you, I've got this. Honestly, I don't care which boys fill in.」
lines.109: Right. If only it would rain tomorrow and get postponed--
